description:
Lists the languages that have at least one translation for the app.
Use when: before horizon_get_localization or horizon_get_all_localizations, to pick a valid lang or build a language menu.
Not for: the texts themselves (use horizon_get_all_localizations).
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {languages, total}, where languages holds ISO 639-1 codes such as 'en' or 'de'; empty when the app has no translations.
Errors: Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).
name: horizon_get_localization_languages

anyOf.description: ISO 639-1 codes with at least one translation

title: Get Localization Languages
